{"reason": "All 34 alt-supplier rows cost 45000 though observed transfer-days are 2-4 and sister stock is usually present; rows like high/10.0 or high/13.2 would be fine with propose-internal-rebalance at 6000. I route medium/high with inventory-days>=5 to rebalance (fallback still times like alt), keeping the high/<5 alert and alt for tighter stock, so stockouts stay flat while cost drops.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (>= inventory-days 5))
     (list 'propose-internal-rebalance))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
